Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mis-scoped the task by insisting on finding the director’s “current employer,” adding an unstated temporal constraint. The original question only asked where the director “works at” (i.e., employer/affiliation), which in common knowledge-base tasks maps to employer without requiring present-tense verification. This misinterpretation led to chasing up-to-date academic status (amid conflicting sources), repeated redundant searches, and no resolution. The later context loss (claiming no previous results) compounded the loop, but the first error originated at Step 0 with the incorrect framing.
